research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Known Medicine is engaged in the development of high-throughput three-dimensional cell-culture systems and methods. These systems are designed to ensure an even distribution of cells across well surfaces, enhancing imaging analysis. This aligns with their focus on using patient-specific 3D cell culture and AI to improve drug translation to clinical success, highlighting their commitment to advancing personalized medicine through innovative cell culture technologies.

overview_description.description: Known Medicine is looking to take the experimentation of how tumors respond to cancer drugs out of the patient’s body and into the lab. The startup breaks down tumor samples into micro tumors, which they treat separately inside specialized micro-environments with different methods and see what works best.
